name: npc_saints-greeter
customDialogue:
Welcome to the Saints HQ. Food bank downstairs, the gym on two, study rooms up top.
Everybody eats here. Everybody trains. Everybody learns.
Ask at the desk if you need anything.

name: npc_saints-mechanic
customDialogue:
Mind the lifts! That purple one is three coats of candy paint.
We fix anything with wheels. And some things without.

name: npc_saints-hooper
customDialogue: Next game is winners stay on. You got next?

name: interiorEntrance_sl_block_party
promptText: Press O to Enter the Block Party

interiorDefinition.title: The Block Party
interiorDefinition.description: Four bowling lanes, pool tables, the DJ booth under the neon, the disco ball.

hotspots.description: Every job the Saints take starts at this table. The halo over it lights up when the whole crew is in the room.
The whole of Los Angeles from one window. The Saints say they look after it; the city has never complained.
Purple keys, gold lines, the halo at centre court. Weekend runs start at noon and end when the lights go off.
Every seat has been sat in by somebody's grandmother yelling at the referee.
Candy purple, gold leaf on the hood, hydraulics that can make it dance. It is never quite finished; that is the point.
Twelve coats of candy paint, each one sanded by hand. The hood in the booth is drying for the third day.
Ask the librarian anything about the city. If it is not in a book here, it is in the librarian.
Sunset over the boulevard, the palms, the cars. Painted by kids from the block one summer.
Four lanes, glow-in-the-dark balls on Friday nights, and a scoreboard that cheers for strikes.
Two turntables, a crate of records and the biggest speakers on the block. The party starts when the needle drops.

spotConfig.label: Read the welcome sign
spotConfig.text: WELCOME TO SAINTS, LOS ANGELES. City of wings. Keep it clean, keep it loud, and if you can hoop, the court is yours. The Saints.

requires.hint: Higher. The HQ has a fire escape round the side.

spotConfig.text: On the HQ roof the whole city opens up: the court, the arena with its gold wings, the hills sign far off. From up here the arena's wings line up with the HQ, as if the building could fly.
You walked all the way out of the city and up the hill. The letters of the sign are taller than the HQ, and somebody has signed their name on the back of the first one: a Saint, of course.
The purple lowrider bounces on its springs as you walk up. Once.
The gold lowrider bounces twice, chrome flashing.
The blue lowrider bounces three times and plays a little horn tune. That is all of them.

requires.hint: The court has a secret, but only after dark.

spotConfig.text: At night the court lights hum, and on the centre circle you can hear it: a ball bouncing, sneakers squeaking, a crowd that is not there. Somebody just hit a game winner.

requires.hint: Up. The apartments have a fire escape.

spotConfig.text: The apartment roof: a lawn chair, a radio, a pot of tomatoes and the best view of the street. Somebody up here watches every game on the court.

requires.hint: The wings shine best at sunset.

spotConfig.text: From here, at sunset, the arena's gold wings sit right behind you. Click. Every Saint has this picture.

spotConfig.label: Walk the street

requires.hint: Wait until the streetlights come on.

spotConfig.startText: All the way along the street, past every light, to the far corner.
spotConfig.failText: You left the street. Start again at the west corner.
spotConfig.text: The whole street, every light: each one flickered as you passed, like the street was saying hello. The far corner light stays on a little longer for you.

spotConfig.label: Look in the planter
spotConfig.text: Curled up in the planter between the flowers, a tiny Saints ant is asleep in the sun. It wakes up, stretches, and whispers something.
